# Blewett

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P13](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P19](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0019)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Mrs. [Peter Blewett](../character/peter-blewett.md) is a small woman with a shrewish-looking face. She possesses an exceptionally lean build, without an ounce of superfluous flesh on her bones.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P10](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0010)_

## Personality

Blewett is characterized by a shrewish demeanor, a fearsome temper, and pronounced stinginess. Her household includes a family of pert and quarrelsome children.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P10](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0010)_

## Traits

- presumed shrewish and stingy with a fearsome temper  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P10](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0010)</sub>

## History

Blewett visited Mrs. Spencer's home, where she offered to take [Anne](../character/anne.md) in as a servant to help with her children and household duties. However, her sharp and shrewish demeanor caused [Anne](../character/anne.md) distress, leading [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to hesitate. Rather than handing [Anne](../character/anne.md) over to Blewett, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) decided to take the girl back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to discuss the matter with [Matthew](../character/matthew.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P1](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P2](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P5](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P11](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P16](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0016), +9 more_
